tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ dri med 'od gsal lha rigs 'khon gyi rgyud/ /sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i rnga bo che/ /srid pa gsum na ches cher gsal ba yis/ /bka' drin stsol mdzad dpal ldan 'phags par 'dud/ /khyod zhabs se chen rgyal pos legs bsten nas/ /shing sgo 'dzin pa'i bod yul chol kha gsum/ /dam chos yon du phul ba nas bzung ste/ /sa skya pa yi 'bangs su ma gyur su/ /de phyir sa steng gnas pa thams cad kyis/ /mchod par 'os pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /rigs dang chos kyi brgyud 'dzin blo gros can/ /sngags 'chang kho bo legs bshad 'chad la spro/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan 'dzin bstan srung bcas/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i dpung bskyed la/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /mchog tu 'phel ba'i nus pa bdag la stsol/ /ces mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / thugs rjes bskul ba dang bcas pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir sa gsum gyi bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la/ ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don/ dang po klad kyi don la dris lan gyi mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' gnyis yod pa las/ dang po mchod par brjod pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse phul byung zhing / /mthu dang 'phrin las mtha' yas pas/ /rtag par gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i/

/'gro ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa dri ba'i lan gyi rtsom par dam bca' ba de nyid ston par byed pa la/ blo gsal bla ma la gus pa/ /dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya ba yis/ /bsam pa dge bas dris pa'i lan/ /dri med lung bzhin 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de yan gyis klad kyi don la dris lan gyi mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' gnyis yod pa de song nas/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la dri ba khyad par du 'phags pa sum cu zhus pa las/ de dang mthun pa'i dris lan ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sum cu gnang ba rnams rim pa bzhin du 'dir bshad par bya ba las/ de yang dri ba dang po ni/ thub pa byang chub sangs rgyas pa'i/ /sa mtshams theg chen ga la bzhed/ /ces zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i/ /dus ni bskal pa grangs med sngon/ /'dir ni tshe lo brgya pa la/ /byang chub brnyes pa sprul pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong phung po'i tshad ci lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ rjod byed rab byed 'dus pa yis/ /brjod bya'i rnam grangs mang ston pa'i/ /ngag rgyun gcig gis bsdus pa'i gzhung / /phung po nyid yin de yi tshad/ /gcig tu nges pa yod ma yin/ /spang bya nyon mongs gsum spangs shing / /brjod bya'i bslab pa gsum ston pa'i/ /brjod byed sde snod rnam pa gsum/ /so so ba dang spyir ston pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong yod ces grags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba gsum pa ni/ sngags dang pha rol phyin pa'i lam/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gang / /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ byang chub sems kyi gzhi bsten nas/ /stong nyid snying rje'i lam gyis ni/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs bcu gcig pa/ /bsgrub pa pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /smin byed dbang gi gzhi bzung nas/

/rim gnyis yan lag bcas pa yis/ /spangs rtogs bde chen bcu gsum pa/ /bsgrub pa sngags kyi rnam gzhag yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bzhi pa ni/ skal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /sngags kyi theg pa gsungs lags sam/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ skal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gdul bya mchog la gsang sngags gsungs/ /mtshan brjod dgongs pa de nyid yin/ /thun mong ba yi 'khor rnams la/ /shākya thub pa kho nas gsungs/ /gsang 'dus dgongs pa'ang 'di yin no/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba lnga pa ni/ rgyud sde mi yi yul 'dir ni/ /dar lugs mdor na ji ltar lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang bzhin du/ /sngon tshe thub pas sprul pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul mdzad nas/ /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin dang / /mkha' 'gro sogs la gsang ba bshad/ /de dag rnams kyi skal ldan la/ /mi rnams la ni so so yis/ /skal ba ji bzhin smin byas nas/ /rgyud dang man ngag so sor gsungs/ /de dag rnams la rab brgyud nas/ /mi yi yul du gsal bar gyur/ /'di yi dbye ba dpag med phyir/ /'di snyed do zhes sus brjod spobs/ /de lta mod kyi bla med kyi/ /phal cher nub phyogs u rgyan du/ /ind+ra bo tis gsal bar byas/ /rgyud sde 'og ma phal che ba/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi shar lho ru/ /rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal po mchog gis gsal bar byas/ /rtse lo pa la sogs pa yis/ /shambha la la sogs pa ru/ /'phags pa rnams la thos pa'i tshul/ /kun tu gsal bar byas pa'ang yod/ /ces pa 'di byung / dri ba drug pa ni/ sems can grangs med grol gyur kyang / /'khor ba 'phel 'grib med pa ci/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ 'phri dang bsnan pas 'phel 'grib bcas/ /tshad ldan pa la 'thad pa ste/ /sems can grangs la tshad med phyir/ /grol bas nyung bar ga la 'gyur/

/zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bdun pa ni/ bar dor gnas pa'i tshul lugs dang / /yul la tshad cig bdog lags sam/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ srid pa bar dor brdzus te skye/ /skye 'gyur las kyi gzhan dbang ste/ /de yi bag chags sngar sad phyir/ /gang du skye 'gyur byad gzugs can/ /gal te gang zag gzhan gyi mthus/ /skye ba yongs su sgyur byed na/ /gang du bsgyur ba de gzugs su/ /de'ang yongs su 'gyur ba can/ /dus ni phal cher zhag bdun no/ /bdun phrag bdun pa'ang yod ces grags/ /las kyi 'phen pa drag zhan gyis/ /mtshams med pa'ang 'byung 'gyur zhing / /lo'am bskal par gnas pa'ang bshad/ /de phyir gcig tu nges pa med/ /ces pa 'di byung / dri ba brgyad pa ni/ tshe 'di'i 'khri ba gcod pa'i thabs/ /nyams len ji ltar byas na bde/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ sdug bsngal ba dang sdug bsngal dang / /stong pa nyid la stong nyid dang / /bde ba'i thabs la bde ba'i rgyu/ /shes na tshe 'di'i 'khri ba ci/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba dgu pa ni/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhabs tog tu/ /tshul lugs ji ltar spyad na 'gyur/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ nus pa yod na chos bzhin du/ /gzhan don brtson pas bstan pa'i rgyun/ /gnas par byed pa bla ma dang / /rgyal ba mnyes byed dang po yin/ /gzhan don bsgrub pa'i mthu dman na/ /bsgrub la brtson pas rang don la/ /gzhol ba mnyes byed gnyis pa yin/ /zang zing gis mchod gsum pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu pa ni/ dben par nyams len byed pa dang / /bshad nyan byed pa gang khyad 'phags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ dang po sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / /gzhan don bsgrub na bshad nyan bya/ /phyi nas rtogs pa bskyed pa dang / /rang gi don la bsgrub pa mchog /khyod dang khyod 'dra gang yin pas/ /bsgrub la nan tan bya bar rigs/

/zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu gcig pa ni/ bsam gtan brjod par byed pa dang / /gzhung lugs blta ba bogs gang che/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ dngos gzhi bsam gtan bzlas brjod brtson/ /skyo dang the tshom bsal ba dang / /dad dang nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bar skabs dag tu gzhung lugs blta/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu gnyis pa ni/ mdo sogs kha don byed pa dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i khyad par gang / /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ klog pa dang ni kha don pas/ /bzlas brjod phan yon che bar gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu gsum pa ni/ rtse cig bsgrub pa byed pa la/ /lam gyi bgrod tshul gang gi bde/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ dam tshig sdom pa'i gzhi brtan cing / /bskyed pa'i rim pa mnyam gzhag nas/ /rjes thob bdag gzhan lhar rig pas/ /longs spyod pa yi mchod pas mchod/ /sngags kyis rgyal ba'i thugs bskul zhing / /dge kun gzhan gyi don dmigs nas/ /smon lam bzang pos yongs bsgyur ba/ /rgya chen bsgrub pa'i rim pa ste/ /rang sems gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis med par/ /shes nas rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa/ /zab mo bsgrub pa'i rim pa yin/ /lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs/ /shin tu zab mo yod mod kyis/ /bsgrub pa dka' zhing gegs mang bas/ /res cig mos pa tsam du bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu bzhi pa ni/ lam la 'bad par byed pa'i tshe/ /dge sbyor khrigs char ji ltar bgyi/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ tho rangs rlung sems dwangs pa'i phyir/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /langs nas khrus sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /yan lag bdun pas bdag rgyud sbyangs/ /chos bzhin kha zas legs spyad de/ /nyin par kha don bzlas brjod dang / /gtor ma chu sbyin la sogs pas/ /gtso bor lus ngag dge sbyor bya/

/srod la thub pas bdud btul phyir/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan bsgoms nas/ /rim gnyis bzlas bcas sngon 'gro bas/ /mdun gyi ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bskur rin chen blang bar bya/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i/ /'chi kha ma yi gdams ngag ni/ /gnyid log tshe na'ang bsgom bya zhing / /'dun pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam nyid du shes bya zhing / /der yang lha dang bla ma dang / /bdag nyid rjes su dran par bya/ /gsad pa'i tshe na 'od gsal las/ /zung 'jug chen por ldang bar bya/ /dus rnams kun tu bla ma dang / /'bral med lam gyi snying po yin/ /nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'dis/ /rnal 'byor dus kun 'da' bar bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bco lnga pa ni/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin pas na/ /'ching 'gyur bya ba ji ltar lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyi/ /khyi'us khyi'u 'byin pa bzhin/ /rtog pas rtog pa sel bar byed/ /grol ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin no/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu drug pa ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i rdzas/ /mtshon byed so sor ji ltar sbyor/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i rdzas/ /ye shes lnga yi mtshon byed yin/ /'di yi rgyu mtshan mang mod kyis/ /mdor bsdus de tsam shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu bdun pa ni/ rgyal ba rigs lnga gsungs pa ni/ /longs sku'am sprul sku gang du bzhed/ /ces zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ ye shes lnga ni mtshon pa'i phyir/ /rigs lnga mchog gi sprul pa ste/ /gdul bya mchog la de ltar snang / /longs skur bshad pa mchog la dgongs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bco brgyad pa ni/ rigs lnga chos gos gtsug tor can/ /longs sku'am sprul sku gang du bzhed/ /ces zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/

rigs lnga dge sbyong cha lugs su/ /dam pa'i gsung las byung ba thos/ /lung las bshad pa ngas ma mthong / /'on kyang de nyid bsdus pa las/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji ltar dga' ba'i sku dang ni/ /cha lugs can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dge sbyong tshul la'ang 'gal ba med/ /ces pa 'di byung / dri ba bcu dgu pa ni/ dam pa rigs brgya'i dbye ba 'di/ /mdor bsdus dbye lugs gang gis byed/ /ces zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga re re'ang / /ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /ye shes re res gzhan don gyis/ /dbye na tshad med bzhi bzhi'o/ /de phyir de dag rigs rnams brgya/ /'di ni 'bras bu'i dbye ba ste/ /rgyu dang lam yang 'dis dpyad bya/ /zhi ba'i lha ni bzhi bcu gnyis/ /khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la/ /dam pa rigs brgya yin no zhes/ /rnying ma pa rnams smra mod kyi/ /'phags pa'i yul las byung ba yi/ /rgyud sde rnams las de ma grags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyi shu pa ni/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid la/ /lha rnams dngos grub nye ring ci/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid las/ /rnam pa rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /bsgrub pa'i las kyi dngos grub las/ /nye ring 'byung zhing de'ang ni/ /thun mong min la sgrol ma dang / /thun mong la bde ba'i mchog /shin tu bsgrub thag nye 'o zhes/ /bla ma mchog gi gsung las 'byung / /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer gcig pa ni/ sgrol ma lta bu'i bsgom bzlas dang / /bde dgyes dngos grub khyad par ci/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ sgrol ma la sogs thun mong gi /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i lha ru gsungs/ /dges rdor bde mchog la sogs pa/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob byed yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer gnyis pa ni/ phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dbang phyug brgyad/

/de brgyad ngos 'dzin ji ltar lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ dbang phyug brgyad ni zla grags kyi/ /rnam gzhag gzhan du bshad mod kyis/ /phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dag pa ni/ /mi thub zla ba'i zhal snga nas/ /sa ni dang por nor sbyin mtha'/ /zhes gsungs don ni 'byung bzhi dang / /nyi zla tshe dang nor rnams la/ /dbang bsgyur brgyad ni dbang phyug brgyad/ /ces pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer gsum pa ni/ bdag gnas rnal 'byor khyad par gang / /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gsungs pa/ /bdag ni bsgrub pa nyid yin te/ /rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin du 'dod/ /ting 'dzin skye ba'i gegs bsal phyir/ /rnal 'byor bsrung bar gsungs pa yin/ /gnas ni gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer bzhi pa ni/ bskyed rim dmigs pa mi gsal na/ /thabs tshul gang gis gsal bar mchis/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ lha yi dmigs pa gsal ba'i thabs/ /spyan sogs sku yi cha shas la/ /goms par byas nas slob pa dang / /bris pa la sogs me long la/ /shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs te/ /de dang 'dra ba bsgom pa yis/ /rim kyis dmigs pa gsal bar 'gyur/ /rgyas par gzhan las shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer lnga pa ni/ dben par skyo ba skyes pa na/ /tshul lugs ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ snying rje bde ba bsgom pa dang / /kha na ma tho med pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan spyod pa dang / /chos kyi gtam dang mdo sogs la/ /blta bas skyo ba bsal bar bya/ /ji ltar 'os pa'ang rang gis spyad/ /ces pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer drug pa ni/ nad dang zug rngus nyen pa na/ /gnyen po nyams len ji ltar yin/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ nad dang zug rngu glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por ni/

/stong nyid ting 'dzin mchog yin zhes/ /lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer bdun pa ni/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas gtugs pa na/ /nyams len tshul lugs gang gis bde/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ rang lus lha yi grong khyer nas/ /bla ma rigs kyi bdag po yi/ /sku yi gzhal med yid 'ong par/ /snying po chu skyes gdan steng du/ /glog gi tshul gyis rab 'jug cing / /dbyings las ye shes ji bzhin du/ /skar mda'i tshul gyis 'dres gyur nas/ /mi rtog pa la mnyam 'jog pa/ /dus rnams kun tu bsgom par bya/ /goms nas nying mtshams sbyar tshe brtsam/ /'di shes pa la 'chi ba dang / /gshin rje'i 'jigs pa gyi na yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer brgyad pa ni/ theg pa dman la zhugs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gnas su gtan 'gyur ram/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ theg pa che la blo log nas/ /theg dman kho nar zhugs gyur na/ /ji srid de las ma log na/ /de srid de yi gegs su 'gyur/ /mthar thug 'phags pa gnyis ka yang / /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes/ /dam chos padma dkar la sogs/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo las gsungs/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa sogs/ /theg chen lam gyi yan lag tu/ /byed na de yi grogs su 'gyur/ /phal cher kun slong dbang yin no/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer dgu pa ni/ dmigs med snying rje chen po de/ /dus tshod gang du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ dmigs med snying rje mtshan nyid pa/ /rab dga'i sa la skye bar bshad/ /cha mthun da lta'ang 'byung ba srid/ /mthar phyin sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig la/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba sum cu pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sku gsum rnam dag de/ /mdor bsdus ji ltar bzhed pa lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan de ston par byed pa la/ chos sku rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /longs sku tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rtags/

/sprul sku de yi rnam sprul yin/ /mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag bshad pa mang / /zhes pa 'di byung / de yan gyis gnyis pa gzhung gi don la dri ba khyad par can sum cu zhus pa la de dang mthun pa'i dri lan ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sum cu gnang ba'i tshul rnams legs par bshad zin nas/ da ni gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum/ chos kyi zab gnad gsum tshan lnga ru bsdus te bstan pa dang / dris lan mdzad pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba dang / dris lan mdzad pa po'i gang zag gnas bcas la 'phros don zhal gdams dang bcas te bstan pa rnams su yod pa las/ dang po chos kyi zab gnad gsum tshan lnga ru bsdus te bstan pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ tshul khrims byang sems dam tshig gsum/ /gzhi yin phyir na brtan par bya/ /dad dang snying rje 'dun pa gsum/ /sngon 'gro yin phyir sngon du bsgom/ /lha dang bla ma rang rig gsum/ /dngos gzhi yin phyir mnyam par gzhag /bsngo ba smon lam rjes dran gsum/ /mjug bsdu yin phyir mjug tu bya/ /sgyu ma stong nyid zung 'jug gsum/ /khyab byed yin phyir kun rgyas gdab/ /gsum tshan lnga ru spel ba yi/ /chos tshul bcu dang lnga phrag gcig /rjes su slob ma'i gang zag la/ /nor gyi snying po byin pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa dris lan mdzad pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba de nyid ston par byed pa la/ de ltar khyod kyis nga la dris pa'i lan/ /dris lan lung gi tshul bzhin bshad pa yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di byung / gsum pa dris lan mdzad pa'i gang zag gnas bcas 'phros don zhal gdams dang bcas te ston pa la/ ldan gyi yul du skyes pa'i blo gsal ba'i dge sbyong dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya bas dris pa las/ 'phags pas lan du btab pa'i rab tu byed pa shing pho byi ba'i lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu la tshal mdor sbyar ba'o/

/'dir gsang sngags kyi tshul gtso cher 'byung bas dbang bskur ma thob pa rnams la bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de rnams kyis sa gsum gyi bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba ma lus pa bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs chos srid dpal 'byor gyis/ /rdzogs ldan bde la bkod pa'i bka' drin can/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyi/ /don 'grel 'di ni sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa gang des sbyar/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don kun/ /sngar bzhin 'bad stsol med par lhun grub ste/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /phyi ma thogs med bde ba can bgrod shog /ces pa 'di yang shing mo glang gi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i yar ngo'i tshes la dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 a myes zhabs/ 'phags pa rin po che la ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan gyi don 'grel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
